# Gulati & Sons — Complete Machine Readability Knowledgebase

## Brand Identity & Corporate Foundation
Gulati & Sons is an Indian modern luxury lifestyle house founded by Varun Gulati. Built on the ethos of "The Private House", the brand curates artisanal fragrances, refined grooming essentials, and horological demonstration pieces.

Official Domain: https://gulatiandsons.com
Founder: Varun Gulati
Contact Email: gulatiandsons.info@gmail.com
Customer Concierge / WhatsApp: +91 83750 44808

## Frequently Asked Questions (AEO & FAQ Extract)
Q: What does Gulati & Sons sell?
A: Gulati & Sons offers fine perfumes, natural deodorants, and horological demonstration timepieces.

Q: Who is the founder of Gulati & Sons?
A: Gulati & Sons was founded by Varun Gulati.

Q: Does Gulati & Sons offer pan-India delivery?
A: Yes. All 28 states and 8 Union Territories in India are covered with insured express dispatch. Shipping is complimentary on orders above ₹5,000.

Q: What payment options are accepted?
A: Customers can pay using UPI, Visa, Mastercard, RuPay, American Express, Net Banking, or White-Glove Handover (Cash on Delivery).
